aboutPage.title: Technology built for our communities
aboutPage.description: TechVision is on a mission to help organizations across Ethiopia and beyond run smarter with secure, scalable, cloud-based software — backed by people who understand the local context.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To empower organizations with affordable, world-class digital tools that simplify operations and elevate outcomes.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A future where every school, institution, and business in the region runs on smart, connected technology.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: Reliability, accessibility, and genuine local partnership guide everything we build and support.

story.heading: From a local idea to a regional platform
story.p1: TechVision started with a simple observation: organizations in our region were doing extraordinary work with tools that held them back. Spreadsheets, paper records, and disconnected systems made growth harder than it needed to be.
story.p2: We set out to change that — building cloud-based software that's powerful enough for enterprises yet accessible to schools and small teams. Today, our LMS, Education ERP, ERP, and HR products help hundreds of organizations operate with confidence.
story.p3: What sets us apart is partnership. Every customer gets onboarding and support from a team that speaks their language and understands their reality.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.description: How we collect, use, and protect your information.

s1.heading: Information we collect
s1.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, organization, and any details you share through our contact form or demo requests.

s2.heading: How we use your information
s2.body: We use your information to respond to inquiries, provide demos, deliver our products, and communicate updates relevant to your account.

s3.heading: Data sharing
s3.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate our platform, under appropriate confidentiality agreements.

s4.heading: Data security
s4.body: We use industry-standard security measures, including encryption and access controls, to protect your data from unauthorized access.

s5.heading: Your rights
s5.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support team.

s6.heading: Cookies
s6.body: We use essential cookies to operate our website and analytics tools to understand how our site is used, in order to improve our services.

s7.heading: Contact us
s7.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please reach out through our contact page.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.description: The terms and conditions that apply when you use TechVision.

s1.heading: Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By accessing or using TechVision's products, you agree to be bound by these terms of service.

s2.heading: Use of services
s2.body: You agree to use our products only for lawful purposes and in accordance with any applicable agreements between you and TechVision.

s3.heading: Accounts and access
s3.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account.

s4.heading: Payment and billing
s4.body: Subscription fees are billed according to the plan you select. Prices and terms may change with reasonable notice.

s5.heading: Intellectual property
s5.body: TechVision retains all rights to its software, branding, and content. You retain ownership of the data you upload to our platform.

s6.heading: Termination
s6.body: Either party may terminate service according to the terms of the applicable agreement. Upon termination, access to the platform will be discontinued.

s7.heading: Limitation of liability
s7.body: TechVision is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from the use of our products, to the extent permitted by law.
